description: PySCF closed-shell RHF (spherical, conv_tol 1e-14, conv_tol_grad 1e-11) over this tree's data/basis files, and PySCF mcscf.CASSCF (conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-7, the lowest singlets at the given weights, checked against mc2step, then polished to |g| < 1e-10) from its frontier orbitals, an explicit 'active' set (0-based RHF orbital indices, by sort_mo) or mcscf.avas's over data/basis/minao.json: at those starting orbitals, the CASCI energies and the sign-invariant parts of mc1step.gen_g_hop's gradient and orbital Hessian (doubled, the derivatives of E) over the weighted RDMs; converged, each root's energy, the weighted energy, the state-averaged Fock's eigenvalues in each space and the state-averaged natural occupations. Hartree; coordinates in bohr
